messages.subject: Announce: Distance 3.5 Release 6 - New distribution
parts:
Hi distance-sampling list,

I have uploaded a new distribution of Distance 3.5 Release 6 to the Distance
web site http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance/

The previous distribution would not install properly on some versions of
Windows 95 and 98. This new distribution contains some extra windows support
files, and should (hopefully) install under all Windows operating systems
(except some non-English versions of Windows, for which there are other known
problems).

If you downloaded Distance 3.5 Release 6 during September, and found that it
wouldn't install on your machine, you should download again and try the new
distribution. If you get any problems, read the ReadMe and let me know if
the problem is not covered there.

If you previously downloaded Distance 3.5 Release 5 or Release 6 and have no
problems with it, then there is no need to download the new distribution.

Cheers,

- Len Thomas
